title: Mary Ann P NDE 7397
content: A few hours after eating a marijuana brownie, my legs became numb and I couldn't talk. My fiance knew something was wrong and kept screaming at me to wake up. From above, I could see her. I was on the ceiling looking down at her trying to tell her to help me. I could see her calling an ambulance and trying to put clothes on me. I was unable to help her, since my legs felt like lead. I floated to a room somewhere, and could see a small door at the far end of the room. A part of me felt like I was supposed to go through the door, but another part of me said, 'No.' Then I saw a figure. I don't know if he was God or what, but I kept telling him to let me go back and that I wanted another chance. I then looked to the left and I could see down, again, into the bedroom. I was in with my body, by then the paramedics where there. One slapped me to wake me up, and picked up my arm, but it just dropped back down. I remember how mean they seemed to me. I looked back to the figure and kept asking him to let me go back. I was so scared. I then looked to the left again. At that point, I'm in the ambulance. I could hear a lady and man laughing at me, saying look at her. Then I remember waking up in the hospital. The sounds were so loud, like I came out of that room and the noises were so intense. When I asked my fiancΘ later, 'Was there a lady and a man that came to the apartment?' She said, 'Yes, how did you know? You were unconscious.'

arrival.other_being_detail: “Then I saw a figure. I don't know if he was God or what…”

environment.environment_other_detail: “I floated to a room somewhere, and could see a small door at the far end of the room.”

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Shifted perspective back to body/bedroom, then ambulance, then woke in hospital.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: A few hours after eating a marijuana brownie; became numb and unable to talk; unconscious until hospital.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Saw a “room” with a “small door” and an unidentified “figure”; later perceived ambulance/hospital sounds while unconscious.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE above body → moved to a room with a door (boundary-like) and encountered a figure → repeatedly shifted view back to bedroom/paramedics and then ambulance → woke in hospital.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived hearing people in the ambulance laughing; later asked fiancée about “a lady and a man” at the apartment and was told they were there while she was unconscious.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was on the ceiling looking down at her…” / “I floated to a room somewhere, and could see a small door…” / “Then I saw a figure. I don't know if he was God or what…” / “I kept telling him to let me go back and that I wanted another chance.”
